info.title: Aransas County at a glance
instructions: CTAF: VHF CH 21 (123.05) · TW-4 KRKP Common: UHF CH 21
ASOS: 119.275 VHF
Left-hand pattern (infield side) for all runways
Break 1,000' · Pattern 800' · High key 3,000' · Low key 1,500'
Max 4 aircraft in the pattern, civilian included
Open 0800–1800 Mon–Thu; an ARDO must be in position
info.source: Binder, pp. 39–40; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slides 30–33.

info.title: Pattern radio calls
info.leadIn: On CTAF (VHF CH 21), each ending "Aransas County Traffic":
instructions: 2 mile initial (RWY #) for a left overhead
Numbers (RWY #), left overhead
Left crosswind (RWY #)
Left base (RWY #), touch and go
info.source: Binder, p. 42; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slide 37.

info.title: Practice PELs
instructions: Authorized for all runways with 2 or fewer aircraft in the pattern
Request from Corpus Approach, announce on CTAF and report High Key on KRKP Common
Call high left crosswind and high left base on CTAF
Practice approaches to a low approach are authorized outside scheduled pattern hours (limit 1 per sortie); circling to a low approach is approved
Practice PELs already in the pattern are unlimited if separated (check with an instructor)
If you doubt a civilian understands your PEL, reset to high key (check with an instructor)

info.title: Warnings
instructions: Extreme caution descending to the initial: traffic may be on course rules at 1,500' over the Intracoastal, inbound from Bayside
Overhead entry from Foxtrot or Mustang: cross the ICW at 2,500' or above
Approaching from the north: overfly the wildlife refuge at 3,000' or above
No instrument approaches while the VFR pattern is open
info.source: Binder, pp. 39–40; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slide 37.
